notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.5a Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.5a Patch Notes ❄

V0.2.5a is out! Small patch with cooking + objective fixes.



UI/UX

Added SFX when a cook completes at the campfire.

Bug Fixes

Fixed uncookable recipes at the campfire: Uncooked Slug Stew, Uncooked Mushroom Soup, Uncooked Sluggers & Mush now cook properly.

Fixed Harvest Small Carcass action sometimes not marking its objective as complete.

Fixed cooked items not marking related objectives as complete (e.g., Melt Snow).

Fixed incorrect remaining time display after a cook completed.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.5 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.5 Patch Notes ❄

This update revamps cooking, improves survival balance, adds clearer feedback (icons, flashes, SFX), and fixes several crashes and edge cases. Thanks for all the reports and playtime!



Gameplay

Cooking revamped: food is now cooked directly at the campfire instead of via crafting.

Added Frozen Potable Water and Frozen Unsafe Water.

Removed Day 1 midnight campfire auto-extinguish event (to avoid confusion).

Activities rebalanced: timings now feel more realistic
(e.g., drinking water now takes 3 minutes instead of 15 — no more leisurely sipping!).

Small carcasses (rat, squirrel, fox) are now movable.

Partial harvests enabled for fallen/dead trees and large carcasses (bear, wolf, fox) instead of one massive 4h+ action.

Campfire warmth increased by 5°C to avoid freezing near fire.

Bedroll warmth buffed to prevent freezing while sleeping.

Crash Site exploration cap removed.

Woods: guaranteed minimum of 2 item types per explore, improved wood drop rates, and capped at 1 cigarette butt.

Torch objective renamed from “Equip” to “Light.”

Starter Campfire now defaults to Torch as the first item.

Tool order for opening cans updated.



UI/UX

Objectives system:

Completed objectives cannot be re-added as active.

Completed objectives now auto-collapse.

Objective text auto-scales to fit.

Tooltip system overhauled: tooltips auto-fit text length (afflictions, sleep, categories, wiki, etc).

Insufficient material/tool tooltip now links to Wiki on click.

Harvested items auto-scroll into view in loot containers.

Over-encumbrance icon added to top-right afflictions panel.

Needs/conditions indicators added:

Up/down arrows show changes each turn.

Flashing warnings when needs/conditions <25%.

Flashing icon for over-encumbrance.

Sleep popup description updated; warmth bonus/punishment displayed.

Card movement controls improved:

Existing Shift + drag and Shift + right-click still work.

Added middle mouse click to move a whole stack.

Added right-click + drag to move a whole stack.

BGM volume reduced across the board; Crash Site music made less piercing.

Added dusk and morning SFX.

Added SFX + notification when items break or rot.



Bug Fixes

Fixed dragging cards left↔right multiple times sometimes freezing the game.

Fixed equipped items being incorrectly counted toward backpack carry weight.

Fixed crafting with multiple firewood types not auto-switching when one type is consumed.

Fixed pluralization issue on hrs/mins labels.

Fixed completed objectives monologue missing punctuation.

Fixed tooltip persistence after hovering buttons (location/crafting/affliction/equipment).

Fixed food poisoning bug that incorrectly increased sanity drain rate when triggered multiple times.

Updated various event monologues; added new ones when needs are depleted.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.4 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.4 Patch Notes ❄

This update adds quality-of-life improvements to sleeping, crafting, and clothing, plus some new player guidance, bug fixes, and a fresh item to help you stay warm.



Gameplay

New item added: Hay (used in crafting, can be dried with grass).

Improved Bedroll recipe now includes Hay.

Starter Bedroll is now provided at the beginning of a new game (starts at 20% durability).

Bedroll durability now decreases based on how many hours you sleep.

Sleep popup now includes warmth bonuses or penalties based on how you sleep.

Added hypothermia warning for Sleeping on the Ground.

Chapter Title scenes and Game Over scenes are now skippable.

Bedroll, Improved Bedroll, and Bearskin Bedroll now require Cloth (not Scrap Cloth) for repair.

Fixed missing warning popup when leaving the Crash Site after max exploration while items remain in the Loot Pile.



UI/UX

Card Details Page now allows equip/unequip of clothing and torches.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/cee7a58da61b313db83c3f657bfcb59b6df44000.gif"]

Equipped items now show durability on the Equipment Page.

“Harvest” button for canned food updated to say “Open” for clarity.

Sleep popup now shows warmth effects (bonus/punishment).

Objectives system updated with better guidance on moving cards.

Objective text now auto-scales height to prevent cutoff.

Fixed issue where tooltips remained visible after mouse was no longer hovering.

Bug report page now checks internet connection before submitting.



Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where sound settings were not saved between sessions.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.3a Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.3a Patch Notes ❄

We’ve patched up some bugs, rebalanced crafting requirements, and made a few quality-of-life updates. Thanks for all the feedback during the demo!



Gameplay

Added confirmation popup when crafting Immovable Items in a Loot Pile.

Immovable Items can’t be picked up once placed. Since Loot Pile contents disappear when you return to the Campsite or travel to another location, the popup warns you before crafting something permanent in a temporary spot.



UI/UX

Updated Under Darkness monologue to include guidance on how to overcome it.

Fixed crafted campfire sometimes not becoming the first item in the container (Loot Pile or Campsite).

Fixed crafted campfire sometimes appearing out of bounds.



Bug Fixes

Fixed New Game → Crafting menu showing clickable Craft button that did nothing.

Fixed combat mode allowing drag-and-drop of animal cards.

Fixed combat mode allowing drag-and-drop of player cards.

Fixed combat mode allowing animal cards to be clicked.

Fixed combat mode allowing player cards to be clicked.

Fixed combat mode showing mouse-over animations on animal cards.

Fixed combat mode showing mouse-over animations on player cards.

Fixed issue where pouring water into a water flask could freeze the game and block progress.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.3 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.3 Patch Notes ❄

This update fine-tunes survival balance, improves UI clarity, and fixes a few issues with location popups and affliction recovery. Canned food also gets a more realistic treatment.



Gameplay

Canned food must now be opened (harvested) before eating.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/868324ade5a9e04c1c013e14394089874572305f.gif"]

Opened canned food can be heated to restore extra warmth and sanity. Eating it cold reduces both.

Harvesting time is now tool-dependent — using a simple shiv to open a can takes longer compared to a hunting knife or can opener.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/1f87fdfa4e843a54661b95137a904def29eaf046.gif"]

Balanced food and drink consumption time taken to be more realistic.

Adjusted food/drink effects: hot or cooked food restores warmth, while cold food reduces it.

Reduced recovery and sleep time needed for afflictions.

Increased chances of finding seats at the Crash Site.

Increased chances of finding grass and wood in the Woods.



UI/UX

Updated affliction sleep time tooltips to be clearer and more informative.

Fixed location card image blocking the bottom part of the popup when scrolled down.

Updated scrollbar colour in the location popup to match the correct theme.



Bug Fixes

Fixed visual overlap in location popup that blocked content when scrolled to the bottom.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.2 Patch Notes ❄

We’ve patched up some bugs, rebalanced crafting requirements, and made a few quality-of-life updates. Thanks for all the feedback during the demo!



Gameplay

Added sanity effects to all foods: eating raw food now reduces sanity, while cooked food restores it.

Cardboard Matches and Wood Matches can now be equipped like a torch, but only last for one turn.

Fixed fresh pelt from squirrel and rat not being able to dry on the Drying Rack.

Fixed crafting recipes that incorrectly used fresh hare/fox pelts instead of the cured versions.



UI/UX

Fixed Fresh Pelt and Gut items showing the wrong card detail popup (appearing as a large, empty space).

Updated Cooked Rat Meat to display the correct icon.

Reduced default sound effect volume from 60% to 40%.

Lowered volume on overly loud sound effects to be more comfortable.

Fixed sound effects not playing when starting a campfire or loading Chapter 2.



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where moving cards after applying filters could leave empty slots and sometimes block further progress.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.2.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.2.1 Patch Notes ❄

We’ve patched up some bugs, rebalanced crafting requirements, and made a few quality-of-life updates. Thanks for all the feedback during the demo!



Gameplay

Crafting Cloth now requires either a Loom or Sewing Kits.

Repairing items now requires Scrap Cloth instead of regular Cloth.



UI/UX

Updated the item description for Scrap Cloth to better reflect its purpose.



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where if Backpack, Campsite, or Lootpile were not set to the “All” filter, crafting an item could result in a black, unclickable card.

Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from collecting items from the Drying Rack.

Fixed a rare issue where cards would move by themselves during Exploration.



As always, we’d love to hear what you think. Join our Discord and tell us how your latest run went.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.7 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.0.7 Patch Notes ❄

We’ve just dropped a new patch for Don't Freeze! Thank you all for the incredible feedback, it’s been a huge help in shaping the game. Here’s what’s new and fixed in Demo Version 0.0.7:

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.6 Now Live!
notes.content:
❄ Demo V0.0.6 Patch Notes ❄

We’ve got some quality-of-life features, gameplay tweaks, and minor bug fixes in this update! Thanks again for all your feedback — it really helps us polish up the demo.



🕹 Gameplay

• Torch can now be crafted in the dark (though it takes double the time)

• Some food/drink can now be consumed in the dark (canned food still not allowed, and it also takes double the time)

• Equipping torch now uses Light/Lighting, and unequipping uses Extinguish/Extinguishing

• Equipping clothing now shows as Wear/Wearing, and unequipping as Take Off/Taking Off



🐞 Bugs

• Fixed a bug where a notification appeared before the crafting animation finished in the crafting popup

• Fixed an issue where the weight of a crafted item was added before the weight of spent items was subtracted, which could briefly push players into an over-encumbered state near the weight limit



⚙ Others

• Added windowed/fullscreen support

• Added resolution change support

• Added Vsync support

• Added support for ultra-wide screens (21:9)



Try out the new version and let us know what you think! You can chat with us and report bugs or feedback over on our Discord.

notes.title: 🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.5 Now Live!
notes.content:
🧊 Don't Freeze – Patch 0.0.5 Now Live!

We’ve just released a new update with bug fixes, balance tweaks, and some UI improvements to make your winter death march just a little smoother. Read on:



🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where moving cards between left and right columns (or vice versa) would display incorrect badge numbers when filtered

Fixed an issue with locale number formatting that caused players to die after the first turn (yes, that was real - thanks Unisus, and no, you did not miss anything, it was our bad)



🎮 Gameplay Updates

Scrap metal can now be found in the Woods (low chance)

Harvesting a seat now gives 3 scrap metal (up from 2) and 4 seat cushions (up from 2)

Harvesting a seat cushion now gives 6 cloth (up from 4)

Rebalanced weight and harvesting values for tinder-related items (sticks, newspapers, etc.)

You no longer start with a free bedroll—you’ll need to craft it

Bedroll crafting now requires rope or cured gut in addition to cloth



🧾 UI & UX Improvements

Your current weight and max capacity now always display at the top of your backpack (next to filters)

The backpack filter now turns red when you’re over-encumbered, as a subtle way of saying “you’ve hoarded too much again”





Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback! If you haven’t already, join our Discord to help shape the future of the game.

👉 Try the latest demo and wishlist the game if you're enjoying it!

Stay warm!

notes.title: Don’t Freeze now live on Steam! Wishlist Us Now!
notes.content:
Welcome Frostbreakers!

We are thrilled to announce that after months of hard work and trudging through the godforsaken wintry lands, Don’t Freeze joins Steam, and here’s all the juicy details!


What is Don’t Freeze?

Don’t Freeze is an open-world survival crafting card game where you play as the lone survivor of a plane crash. Stripped of your familiar urban comforts, you must learn raw, primal skills to endure the brutal cold. Venture into a desolate land where every decision is a battle against the elements—and against the isolation that threatens to consume you.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483580/948bda7b6cdab3d5543dd7690a94a3196a140e71.gif"]
Here are some of the things you can expect to experience:


 Explore & Gather: Roam through nature and a nearby town to find vital resources to fuel your survival.


 Stay Warm: Master the art of the campfire—your only barrier against the biting cold. Will you conquer the chill or succumb to frostbite?


 Feed Yourself: Scavenge, hunt, and forage to maintain your strength in a world where hunger is as relentless as the winter winds.


 Craft & Build: Transform raw materials into tools and shelter. In this unforgiving environment, surviving isn’t enough—you must thrive.


 Stay Sharp: Loneliness in a cold, harsh world can play tricks on your mind. Was that a distant figure, or just the echo of your own footsteps?


 Immersive Narrative: Fragments of your past emerge like whispers on the wind. As you slowly piece together who you are, a mysterious presence lingers in the shadows, hinting at darker secrets yet to be revealed.




Here’s our trailer in case you missed it.[previewyoutube="ccT_3AhQOyA;full"][/previewyoutube]


We hope this glimpse into Don’t Freeze piques your interest. Follow our Steam page, add the game to your wishlist, and stay tuned for updates on new developments, playtests, and behind-the-scenes insights. For even more, subscribe to our newsletter or join the Frostbreaker Discord server.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435110/Dont_Freeze_A_Winter_Card_Survival/"][/dynamiclink]

Stay warm, stay vigilant, and above all—don’t freeze.
